Inline examples separately preserve their source paragraph, section, line and exact byte span; they are not fictional fences. Mere inline syntax/type/identifier mentions and non-standalone expression fragments are not executable examples.

WITH candidate AS (
  SELECT merchant_id, id FROM deliveries
  WHERE merchant_id = $1 AND state = 'queued'
  ORDER BY created_at, id
  LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE deliveries AS d
SET state = 'processing', worker_id = $2, attempts = d.attempts + 1,
    lease_until = transaction_timestamp() + interval '5 minutes'
FROM candidate AS c
WHERE (d.merchant_id, d.id) = (c.merchant_id, c.id)
RETURNING d.id, d.event_id, d.attempts, d.lease_until;

documents.title: Native language 3 of 4 — schemas, online changes and migrations

blocks.source:
create schema billing;

create type billing.delivery_state as enum
  ("queued", "processing", "delivered", "failed");

create table billing.endpoints (
  merchant_id int64,
  id int64,
  url text,
  primary key (merchant_id, id)
);

create table billing.deliveries (
  merchant_id int64,
  id int64,
  endpoint_id int64,
  provider text,
  event_id text,
  state enum billing.delivery_state default "queued",
  attempts int32 default 0,
  worker_id nullable text,
  lease_until nullable timestamp,
  last_error nullable text,
  payload nullable json,
  created_at timestamp default now(),
  primary key (merchant_id, id),
  constraint event_per_endpoint unique (merchant_id, endpoint_id, provider, event_id),
  constraint nonnegative_attempts check (attempts >= 0),
  constraint delivery_endpoint foreign key (merchant_id, endpoint_id)
    references billing.endpoints (merchant_id, id) on delete restrict
) partition by hash (merchant_id);

create index billing.delivery_queue on billing.deliveries
  (merchant_id, state, created_at, id);

create table billing.outbox (
  merchant_id int64,
  id uuid,
  kind text,
  delivery_id int64,
  primary key (merchant_id, id)
);

create view billing.failed_deliveries as (
  billing.deliveries where state = "failed" select merchant_id, id, endpoint_id, created_at
);
